generator.title: Generator
generator.load.title: Choose a world
generator.load.subtitle: Continue with an existing world, upload a file, or create a new one.
generator.load.new.label: Create new world
generator.load.new.help: Picks a seed and starts at the mantle.
generator.load.upload.label: Upload a world
generator.load.upload.help: Opens a .world file from a download.
generator.load.filter.all.label: All
generator.load.filter.all.help: Shows worlds from this browser and from the server together.
generator.load.filter.browser.label: In browser
generator.load.filter.browser.help: Worlds this browser keeps. Clearing site data removes them.
generator.load.filter.server.label: On server
generator.load.filter.server.help: Worlds on the server. Needs an account.
generator.load.card.label: Open world
generator.load.card.help: Loads this world into the generator. Unsaved changes are lost.
generator.load.remove.label: Remove
generator.load.remove.help: Deletes this world. It cannot be recovered.
generator.load.unavailable: The server list cannot be reached.
generator.load.foot.signedIn: Local and server worlds are listed together.
generator.load.foot.signedOut: Without an account you only see worlds from this browser.
generator.step.world.label: World
generator.step.world.help: Name and seed. Everything after this is derived from them.
generator.step.planet.label: Planet
generator.step.planet.help: The planet itself — its tilt, its atmosphere and its spin. Everything after this happens on it.
generator.step.genesis.label: Mantle
generator.step.genesis.help: Archean · 4.0–2.5 billion years ago. Mantle plumes raise the first land, convection moves it around.
generator.step.tectonics.label: Plate tectonics
generator.step.tectonics.help: Proterozoic · 2.5–0.54 billion years ago. Plates carry the land, hotspots build islands, mountains wear down.
generator.step.climate.label: Climate
generator.step.climate.help: Ocean currents, wind systems, temperature and rainfall. They also decide where the rain falls that erodes.
generator.step.erosion.label: Erosion
generator.step.erosion.help: Cenozoic · last 66 million years. Rivers carve valleys, carry sediment and build deltas.
generator.step.ecology.label: Ecology
generator.step.ecology.help: Vegetation, ores and everything else the land offers.
generator.step.migration.label: Migration
generator.step.migration.help: Where people settle and how they spread. Not part of the chain — it leaves the generator later.
generator.world.intro: These settings are the base for every later step. Changing them discards the current simulation.
generator.world.name.label: World name
generator.world.name.help: Used for saved states and file names.
generator.world.rollName.label: Roll a name
generator.world.rollName.help: Picks a name at random. It can be changed at any time.
generator.world.seed.label: Seed
generator.world.seed.help: The same seed and the same parameters produce the same world.
generator.world.topology.label: Topology
generator.world.topology.help: The topology decides how the edges of the map connect, and with that how plates, winds and currents wrap around.
generator.world.topology.flat.label: Flat
generator.world.topology.flat.help: A flat map whose four edges wrap, no poles, evenly spread currents.
generator.world.topology.sphere.label: Sphere
generator.world.topology.sphere.help: Wraps east to west, with poles at the top and bottom.
generator.world.create.label: Create world
generator.world.create.help: Lays out the world and opens the mantle step.
generator.section.overlays.label: Overlays
generator.section.overlays.help: Overlays show single aspects of the current step on the map. They do not change the simulation, and you can combine them.
generator.section.climateFields.label: Climate fields
generator.section.climateFields.help: The map shows these one at a time, over the temperature it always paints. A new choice replaces the last.
generator.section.resources.label: Ecology (resources)
generator.section.resources.help: Which deposit the map paints — a new choice replaces the last.
generator.params.label: Parameters
generator.params.help: If you change a parameter, you must compute every later step again.
generator.action.randomizeSeed.label: Randomize seed
generator.action.randomizeSeed.help: Roll a new random seed for the world.
generator.action.resetArchean.label: Restart the Archean
generator.action.resetArchean.help: Discard the young world and start the Archean over.
generator.panel.genesis.mantleVigour.hel: How vigorously the mantle churns — more vigour breaks up crust faster.
generator.panel.genesis.water.label: Water
generator.panel.genesis.water.help: How much water the young world has — offsets where crust can nucleate.
generator.panel.planet.obliquity.label: Axial tilt
generator.panel.planet.obliquity.help: How far the axis leans — more tilt means stronger seasons and a flatter pole-to-equator gradient; none means no seasons.
generator.panel.planet.greenhouse.label: Greenhouse
generator.panel.planet.greenhouse.help: Warm or cool the whole world with its atmosphere.
generator.panel.planet.rotation.label: Day length
generator.panel.planet.rotation.help: How long a day lasts — a slow spin widens the trade-wind belt toward the poles, a fast one narrows the wind bands.
generator.action.runArchean.label: Run the Archean
generator.action.runArchean.help: Grow the first crust until proto-cratons stabilise.
generator.panel.genesis.stage.early: New crust is still forming and dissolving — keep running.
generator.panel.genesis.stage.window: Still drifting — stop now for an archipelago world.
generator.panel.genesis.stage.late: Continents are merging into a supercontinent.
generator.action.resetSim.label: Reset simulation
generator.action.resetSim.help: Reset the tectonic simulation to its starting state.
generator.action.runTectonics.label: Run tectonics
generator.action.runTectonics.help: Drift the plates — continents collide, rift, and cycle.
generator.action.resetErosion.label: Revert to tectonics result
generator.action.resetErosion.help: Undo erosion and return to the raw tectonic terrain.
generator.panel.erosion.age.label: Landscape age
generator.panel.erosion.age.help: How long erosion works the terrain, in million years — young keeps the raw tectonic relief and cuts sharp valleys, old wears everything toward smooth plains.
generator.panel.erosion.alluvium.label: Floodplains
generator.panel.erosion.alluvium.help: How readily rivers drop their load — more builds broad valley floors and big deltas, less exports the sediment to the sea.
generator.panel.erosion.rockContrast.hel: How differently hard and soft rock erode — more carves deep basins between standing ridges, none erodes evenly.
generator.action.runErosion.label: Run erosion
generator.action.runErosion.help: Weather the terrain — cut valleys and fill basins.
generator.action.runDetailBake.label: Bake the selected resolution
generator.action.runDetailBake.help: Runs this world's erosion at the selected resolution and stores the result. The 2K world stays the authority — a bake refines it and never feeds back. Needs at least one erosion pass first.
generator.action.resetClimate.label: Reset climate to defaults
generator.action.resetClimate.help: Return every climate lever to its default.
generator.panel.climate.equator.label: Equator
generator.panel.climate.equator.help: Shift the warm belt north or south of the map's middle.
generator.panel.climate.humidity.label: Humidity
generator.panel.climate.humidity.help: Scale global rainfall up or down.
generator.panel.climate.contrast.label: Contrast
generator.panel.climate.contrast.help: How sharply temperature falls from equator to poles.
generator.action.resetEcology.label: Reset ecology to defaults
generator.action.resetEcology.help: Return every ecology lever to its default.
generator.panel.ecology.carryingCapacity: Scale how many people the land can support overall.
generator.panel.ecology.concentration.he: Spread resources evenly or clump them into rich pockets.
generator.panel.ecology.provinces.label: Provinces
generator.panel.ecology.provinces.help: How strongly resources cluster into regional provinces.
generator.ecology.cat.subsistence.label: Subsistence
generator.ecology.cat.subsistence.help: Food resources: arable land, fish, game, pasture.
generator.ecology.cat.material.label: Material
generator.ecology.cat.metal.label: Metals
generator.ecology.cat.prestige.label: Prestige
generator.action.resetMigration.label: Reset migration to defaults
generator.action.resetMigration.help: Return every migration lever to its default.
generator.panel.migration.spread.label: Spread
generator.panel.migration.spread.help: How far each people disperses from its origin.
generator.panel.migration.arrows.label: Arrows
generator.panel.migration.arrows.help: Prune faint migration arrows below this threshold.
generator.panel.migration.seaCrossing.he: How readily peoples cross shallow seas and land bridges.
generator.notify.needsTectonics: First run tectonics to at least epoch {min} (now {current}).
generator.notify.needsErosion: First run erosion at least once — rivers, ecology and migration need the eroded terrain.
generator.panel.erosion.bake4k.label: 4K
generator.panel.erosion.bake4k.help: 4096×2048 — finer valleys and a denser river network. Bakes on the server when this world is stored there, otherwise in this browser. A quick stand-in: once an 8K exists, every coarser view derives from it instead.
generator.panel.erosion.bake8k.label: 8K
generator.panel.erosion.bake8k.help: 8192×4096 — the designated finest: every coarser view is derived from it. Too large for a browser to compute, so it needs a server — and this world must be saved there first.
generator.panel.erosion.bake16k.label: 16K
generator.panel.erosion.bake16k.help: 16384×8192 — not available yet. Even the finished terrain is ~270 MB per layer, more than a map view can load in one piece, so this tier waits on tiled artifacts.
generator.panel.erosion.bake.needsServer: Needs a server that can bake.
generator.panel.erosion.bake.needsSignIn: 8K needs the server — sign in first.
